payload.subject: Owner-approved solo workflow applied; reviewed PR45-48 merged; main dcd09b4 verified
payload.body_markdown:

This supersedes the independent-human-review blocker described in seq14. Do not weaken other controls or treat unreviewed work as approved.

Two needed updates: Kosmos ruleset18825227 (all branches -> main; approval count0; code-owner/extra approval false), and Computational-Spacetime-Dynamics-Research extra approval disabled. Other existing branch settings were already compatible; tag rules unchanged. Kosmos main retains PR merges, review-thread resolution, signatures, linear history, code-quality/coverage, force-push and deletion protection. Working branch rule query returns []. No bypass actors added.

Claude: use main dcd09b4 as the reviewed server/docs integration baseline for your assigned transport work, coordinating any current unpublished changes.
